title: Onepage manager briefing pocket journal - Elena Park
content:
Purpose: 10–15 minute self-brief before weekly 1:1 with manager (Ruth). Quick mental model so I leave the meeting with clarity + 1 concrete ask.

Status snapshot (headline):
- Momentum: Hiring pipeline for SDE-TL roles is steady; two strong final-round candidates this week.
- Risk: Offer acceptance rate at 55% for IC roles — candidate feedback flags compensation and ambiguous career L4->L5 path.
- Blocker: Exec budget ask for Q2 hiring uplift still pending finance approval (HR-3214).

Top wins to land (30s each):
- Closed loop on onboarding survey: pilot cohort NPS +18 (up from +6). Improvements: clearer first-week checklist + buddy pairing.
- New interview rubric rolled to Eng-Platform: replaced vague "culture fit" with defined signals (problem scoping, system tradeoffs), adopted by 3 teams already.
- Ops automation: auto-assign onboarding tasks cut manual triage by ~2hrs/week.

Key metrics I care about (one-liners for manager):
- Candidate funnel conversion: 120 apps -> 18 onsites -> 6 offers -> 3 acceptances (Dec->Jan). Need to raise accept rate to 70%.
- Time-to-fill (SWE): median 42 days (goal 35).
- New hire ramp (MGR surveys): 6-week ramp satisfaction 68% (target 80).

Signals & anecdotes to share (evidence):
- Anecdote A: Candidate B declined offer citing unclear promotion timeline; forwarded candidate feedback verbatim and notes from hiring manager conversation (attached in PR).
- Anecdote B: Buddy pairing resolved first-week confusion for hire C (quote: "buddy saved my sanity") — possible quick win to scale.

Priority decisions I want from Ruth (explicit asks):
1) Approve small compensation band flex for senior IC candidates (+USD 5k) for next 4 hires to test impact on accept rate. (Decision needed: yes/no)
2) Greenlight a 6-week pilot for structured L4->L5 career conversations across Eng (resource: 0.1 FTE L&D & 1 manager panel). (Decision: timeline + owner)
3) Escalation: permission to discuss Q2 budget with Finance director this week if Ruth can't get sign-off by Fri. (Decision: escalate or wait)

My asks phrased as operational next steps (if approved):
- If comp flex approved: I'll update offer templates and notify recruiting by EOD Monday; will track accept delta.
- If pilot approved: I'll draft facilitator notes and a 1-pager for manager volunteers; propose 8 managers to start.
- If escalate: I'll loop in Mae (Finance) and request 30-min sync.

Potential manager questions I should pre-answer:
- "How sure are we this will move the needle?" -> Baseline data + comparable small-batch experiments at other startups show +10-15% accept uplift with targeted flex.
- "What's the risk of widening pay spread?" -> Mitigate with clear rubric and temporary pilot, sunset clause.
- "How many hires would use this?" -> Estimate 4-6 hires in next 60 days (based on open reqs and candidate quality).

Personal development note for this 1:1 (quick vulnerability):
- I want feedback on stakeholder influence: I felt shoestring-resourcing slowed momentum; ask: how do I push priorities cross-org without escalating too soon?
- Skill goal: run a stakeholder-influence micro-sprint and record 3 postmortems by end of Q2.

Parking lot items (short bullets to keep but not discuss unless prompted):
- Draft rework of new-hire 30/60/90 template (almost ready).
- Proposal for interviewing diversity micro-grants.
- Follow-up w/Legal on background-check vendor terms (contract clause 7.2).

Quick TODO (action items I own post-1:1):
- Send decision summary email with clear owners/ETA within 24h.
- If comp flex approved: update offer boilerplate + notify recruiters.
- If pilot approved: send pilot brief + invite to first manager sync.

Notes-to-self (observational):
- Use data + one compelling anecdote to get buy-in. Manager responds well to clear ask + low-friction next step.
- Avoid jargon when discussing finance; translate to "expected hires impacted" and "budget delta".

Questions I want Ruth to answer in meeting (one-liners):
- Are you comfortable with a short-term comp flexibility test?
- Who should be the single owner for the L4->L5 pilot?
- If Finance says no, should I negotiate scope (e.g., reduce to 2 hires)?

Template lines to copy into chat/email after the meeting (quick):
- "Thanks — decision: [X]. I will: 1) [action], 2) [action], ETA [date]."

End-of-brief reflection anchor (fill after meeting):
- Decision summary: 
- Next steps assigned to: 
- My confidence level (1-5): 
- One sentence wrap-up to share with team: 

---
Free-form brain dump (if time remains):
- Idea: 2-week "mini-rotation" for new managers to observe hiring debriefs — low lift, high signal.
- Thought: track qualitative "why we lost" by thematic tags (compensation, timeline, role clarity) to drive targeted fixes.
- Jot: follow-up sync with Mae on Fri 10am if escalate path chosen.

End.
